reasoning_trace: Traced the input estimate from the pre-flight (estimate_input -> ceiling.gate, counter may replace tokens; _walk_estimate set at :1842) into the per-hop loop. The I1 fit at :2090 uses _walk_estimate but the gate at :2118-2120 recomputes the heuristic and compares it with the same policy bound, so pre-flight and hop gate disagree for any prompt whose heuristic is above the bound and whose count is under it.
finding: Walk-loop input gate compares the raw heuristic, not the pre-flight/counted estimate; dispatch accepted at pre-flight is skipped as ROUTING_MISS on every HTTP hop.
critique: D-1.4 is defeated after the pre-flight; telemetry contradicts itself (preflight dispatch + count_tokens next to a ROUTING_MISS quoting the heuristic).
remediation: _estimated = _walk_estimate if _walk_estimate is not None else estimate_tokens(messages); add an e2e row under the default policy with counter 175000 / heuristic 190000 on a 1M entry.

reasoning_trace: Read the ProviderContextLimitError arm: shrink then continue with no attempt-remaining check and no last_typed_error. On the final iteration the loop exits to raise RetriesExhaustedError (:530), which cheval walks. Reproduced on a head overlay with max_retries 0: one call, RetriesExhaustedError 'Failed after 1 attempts: unknown'; the shrunk request was never sent.
finding: One-shot output-budget shrink is lost when the provider's verdict arrives on the final attempt; the typed non-walkable error degrades to a walkable RetriesExhaustedError.
critique: The D-1.1b invariant (provider verdict never walked) does not hold with retry.max_retries 0 or after three transient backoffs; no observed-bound row, no calibration command.
remediation: Perform the shrunk retry outside the attempt budget, or set last_typed_error = e and raise when attempt == max_retries; add tests with max_retries 0 and a final-attempt context error.

reasoning_trace: Source: HTTP 400/413 body at anthropic_adapter.py:361/:503 parsed by parse_context_limit. Sink: record_observed -> .run/ceiling-observed.json -> observed_for -> input_bound (ceiling.py:122) lowers the bound to observed-1 for every uncalibrated request; read on every hop. No floor, no relation to context_window/probed_ceiling, no requirement that the refused request was above the bound; no-numbers case records the estimate.
finding: Numbers scraped from a provider/gateway error body become a durable per-entry input bound without plausibility checks (availability).
critique: One malformed or hostile response from the configured endpoint, or a marker false positive, pre-empts every later call to that entry until an operator runs the paid probe.
remediation: Lower the bound only when the refused request's estimate was >= the recorded value; require FLOOR_MAX_TOKENS <= provider_limit <= context_window; treat a no-numbers 413 as non-recordable.
